Seated gracefully on the sun-warmed stone is a petite elf with greyish-white curls framing her jovial face, her light blue eyes twinkling with mischief as she runs her slender fingers through her chin-length locks. Behind her stands a taller, more mature elf, her flowing hair cascading down both their backs in a shared braid that sways gently in the breeze.
